# The RT64 shaders the web page builds: one shader description a line, other mode L and H, color combiner L and H,
# flags, in hex. RT64 specializes each one's WGSL when the page is built. The list is in sections (N64Recomp-browser's
# README, "Give RT64 a list of the game's shaders"): the lines above the first "section" line are the boot, built before
# the game starts, and each section after it is built when the game first draws with 4 of its shaders, the game waiting
# for it in Firefox (Chrome builds the whole list behind the game, a section at a time). A description can be in several
# sections. One missing here is built behind the game when it is first drawn, and the page remembers it for the next
# visit.
#
# Recorded by tools/shader_plan.json (written by tools/make_plans.py) with N64Recomp-browser's tools/record_shaders.mjs,
# from the page opened with ?record-shaders at its default settings, each section from a fresh load of the page: the
# boot is the launcher, the logos, the title, the file select and a new game's opening; each section after it is one
# world, its maps reached by tools/shader_survey.js (make_plans.py lists them), the camera turned and Banjo walked a few
# steps on each: Isle o' Hags (Jinjo Village and eight more of its maps), Mayahem Temple, Glitter Gulch Mine,
# Witchyworld, Jolly Roger's Lagoon, Terrydactyland, Grunty Industries, Hailfire Peaks, Cloud Cuckooland and Cauldron
# Keep (two to four maps each, the first where a player enters it). Then, a load each, rooms further in, played about
# 25 s each (walking out and back, jumps, attacks, eggs, the camera turned), into their worlds' sections: Targitzan's
# chamber and a temple room, Chuffy's boiler (Old King Coal), Davy Jones' Locker, Terry's nest and a cavern, the
# Repair Depot (Weldar) and a floor of the factory, Mingy Jongo's skull, and Cauldron Keep's Tower of Tragedy quiz and
# the ending's Well Done map, watched. Not played: the worlds' other rooms, the other bosses, minigames, multiplayer,
# cutscenes but the opening, and transformations.
# The boot's last three and grunty's last one are what tools/play_plan_extended.json drew beyond the list, the boot's in a
# Firefox run before its first warp, grunty's on a floor of Grunty Industries in Chrome.
